# Big Splash

> Big Splash is a church marketing agency in Georgetown, Texas, north of Austin. It makes Christmas Eve invitation videos for churches and runs them as Facebook and Instagram ads to families within a 10-minute drive of each church. The ad budget is included and there is no contract. Every family who plans a visit gets a welcome text from the church.

Big Splash works with churches across Texas, and its Christmas Campaign also works for churches outside Texas. Founder: Chris List. Pastors book a free 30-minute call to plan a campaign.

## Christmas 2026

- [Christmas Eve campaigns for churches](https://bigsplash.church/christmas/): both options, the four steps and the FAQ. Christmas Eve 2026 is Thursday, December 24.
- [Christmas Eve ads for Texas churches](https://bigsplash.church/christmas/texas/): Christmas Eve invitations for churches across Texas, from Austin and Dallas-Fort Worth to Houston, San Antonio, El Paso and the Rio Grande Valley.
- [Christmas Eve ads for churches: the 2026 guide](https://bigsplash.church/christmas/guide/): when to start, what to put in the invitation, who should see it and how to follow up with every family.

## Christmas options

- Christmas Campaign: 3 invitation videos edited from the church's livestream and phone clips, Facebook and Instagram ads to families within a 10-minute drive with $500 of ad budget included, a Christmas plan-your-visit page, a welcome text and a reminder for every family who plans a visit, and the names of those families sent to the welcome team every Saturday. One payment, and nothing renews.
- VIP Filmed Christmas, for Texas churches: everything in the Christmas Campaign, plus a filming day of up to 6 hours at the church and 6 invitation videos, with $1,000 of ad budget. The church keeps all the raw footage.
- Churches approve every video and page before anything runs. Invitations run from Big Splash's ad account under the church's name and page, so the church needs no ad account of its own.

## Year-round

- [Church marketing for local churches](https://bigsplash.church/): the monthly plan, with Facebook and Instagram ads included.
- [Free Claude files for church staff](https://bigsplash.church/prompts/): including a plan-your-visit page checklist and first-visit follow-up texts.
